aboutH2: Gobind Wellness: 10-day outpatient addiction program in NW Calgary
intro: Gobind Wellness is a private addiction counselling and recovery coaching practice with a Calgary office in Suite 340 at 600 Crowfoot Crescent NW. Founder Bobby Bains, an addictions counsellor and recovery coach, does the in-person work himself. There are no beds and no medical staff. You keep living at home, and many clients never visit the office because Bobby comes to them.

The main offer is a 10-day outpatient program: two hours one to one every day, then an evening community support meeting, 30 hours over 10 days in a row. The practice pitches it at Calgarians who cannot leave work or family for a month in residential rehab. A 30-day live-in option, with a recovery specialist staying with you, is available for people who need more supervision.

pillars.title: Ten themed days, then a meeting every night
pillars.body: The Calgary program moves in a set order. Days 1 to 3 look at how the addiction started, the places and moods that set it off, and the stories people tell themselves to keep going. Days 4 to 6 work on emotions, daily habits and building an identity that is not about drinking or using. Days 7 and 8 cover relationships, boundaries and what you want your life to be for. On day 9 you write a relapse prevention plan, and day 10 ties everything together. After each two-hour session you go to a local evening meeting, so by the end you already know a few rooms in Calgary.

pillars.title: Doing the work where the drinking happened
pillars.body: Sessions can take place in your own house, whether that is in Tuscany, Royal Oak, Arbour Lake or somewhere across the city in the southeast, or in the office at Crowfoot. The idea is simple: you practise new habits in the same kitchen, commute and evenings that used to lead to a drink or a hit. That suits people who keep working through the program. It is less suited to anyone in heavy daily use who may need medical withdrawal care, which Gobind Wellness does not provide.

pillars.title: The 30-day live-in option and aftercare
pillars.body: For closer supervision, the practice offers a 30-day live-in program in Calgary. A recovery specialist stays with you around the clock at home or in Gobind Wellness accommodation, with random testing, exercise, meal prep, group and one-to-one sessions and daily meetings. The website does not say where its accommodation is, and this is not a licensed residential facility. Whichever program you do, aftercare includes phone support for you and your family, help finding a sponsor and home group, a 24-hour contact number and check-ins at one, three and six months.

overview: Bobby Bains started Gobind Wellness in South Surrey and later opened the Calgary office in Crowfoot. He studied psychology and health sciences at Simon Fraser University, holds a life coaching certificate from Erickson College and talks openly about getting sober from alcohol himself. The website does not list a registration with a counselling college or addiction professional body.

Two kinds of work run through the program. Counselling looks at why the drinking or drug use started and what keeps it going. Recovery coaching is practical, covering routine, accountability and how to get through a tough evening without using. The program is built around the 12 steps and community meetings, and the practice describes its spiritual side as not tied to any religion.

faqIntro: Answers come from Gobind Wellness's own website and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: Is Gobind Wellness in Calgary an inpatient rehab?
faqs.a: No. It is a private outpatient counselling and recovery coaching practice in NW Calgary, and you live at home during the 10-day program. Sessions take place at your home or at the office on Crowfoot Crescent. A separate 30-day live-in option puts a recovery specialist with you around the clock, but that is supervised support and not a licensed residential treatment facility.

faqs.q: How does the 10-day program work in Calgary?
faqs.a: You meet Bobby Bains for two hours a day, one to one, on 10 consecutive days, then attend a one-hour community support meeting each evening. That adds up to 30 hours. Each day has its own focus, from triggers and denial early on to relationships, purpose and a written relapse prevention plan near the end. The practice says it limits how many people start in each intake.

faqs.q: What does Gobind Wellness cost in Calgary?
faqs.a: Single counselling or recovery coaching sessions are $190 an hour. The 10-hour online program is listed at $1,800, and the 10-day in-person and 30-day live-in programs are priced on request, so call for a quote. Everything is paid when you book, and programs can be moved once but are not refunded.

faqs.q: Is it covered by Alberta Health Care or Recovery Alberta?
faqs.a: No. Gobind Wellness is a private-pay service, so Alberta Health Care (AHCIP) and Recovery Alberta do not fund it. The practice does not bill insurers directly either. You can send your receipts to your extended health or workplace benefits plan, but check first whether it covers an addictions counsellor or recovery coach.

faqs.q: Can I detox at Gobind Wellness?
faqs.a: No. The practice does not provide medical detox, and its website says its staff are not doctors. It asks new clients to see their family physician about withdrawal before they start. If you drink heavily every day or use opioids or benzodiazepines, arrange medically supervised withdrawal first, through your doctor or Recovery Alberta's detox services.

faqs.q: Where is the Calgary office and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The office is in Suite 340 at 600 Crowfoot Crescent NW, Calgary, AB T3G 0B4, in the Crowfoot shopping and office area. It is about 20 to 25 minutes by car from downtown Calgary via Crowchild Trail and close to Crowfoot CTrain station on the Red Line. Many clients never come to the office, because sessions can happen at home anywhere in Calgary and nearby communities.

faqs.q: Do you have to live in Calgary to do the program?
faqs.a: No. The website lists Calgary, northwest and southeast Calgary and surrounding communities as its Alberta service area, and offers virtual sessions across Canada. Bobby Bains will also travel to clients elsewhere in the country, with extra charges for bookings outside Calgary and the Lower Mainland of BC.

Bobby Bains founded Gobind Wellness and delivers its 10-day program as an addictions counsellor and recovery coach. His bio says he studied psychology and health sciences at Simon Fraser University and holds a life coaching certificate from Erickson College, and he writes about his own recovery from alcohol. The website does not name a professional registration or college membership, so ask if your benefits plan requires one.

faqs.q: Is this the same practice as Gobind Wellness in Surrey?
faqs.a: Yes. Gobind Wellness has two offices, this one in Calgary and another in South Surrey, BC, with the same founder, phone number and price list. We list the Surrey office separately as Gobind Wellness Surrey. Calgary clients work with the Crowfoot office or have sessions at home in the Calgary area.

Phone support for you and your family continues once the program ends. The practice's aftercare includes regular community meetings, help finding a sponsor and a home group, a 24-hour contact number and in-person check-ins at one, three and six months of sobriety. You can keep booking hourly counselling or coaching sessions as well.

faqs.q: How do I book a start date?
faqs.a: Call 778-868-0468, which is the practice's main line for both offices. The Calgary page describes three steps: a confidential call with an addictions specialist, a short intake assessment, then reserving a place in an upcoming 10-day program. The website says most people can start within a few days.
